name: Hopalope · Gremlet #27
description:
A jackalope: a rabbit with tiny antlers. Shy, fast, and absolutely real.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Hopalope in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
